title: sds-factor-vintage-selection-v1
description: Append-only policy for explicit factor-vintage selection. Factor sets/values are first-class bitemporal inputs. Ratified in VARCH-0; selection enforced in the VARCH-6 resolver. Factor-set schema must pin source authority, dataset id/version, evidence/package hash, license id/version, redistribution/usage rights, access scope, steward, author, approver.

selection_strategy.description: How a factor vintage is chosen for a given valid/decision slice. Must be explicit and deterministic.
